notes:
Replication statistics are explicitly supplied author-derived primary table values; no calculations performed here. Coded replication scores alone are not treated as authors’ narrative verdict. Original full primary source unavailable through attempted free routes; secondary table original values not extracted.
Source follow-up: Published title and DOI match the assigned original reference. The supplied page reports descriptive behavioral proportions without a printed test statistic or p-value. Adjacent printed p. 34 reports several different eye-fixation t tests; none is selected because the supplied locator does not uniquely identify any of those outcomes. target_match remains null because a target inferential test cannot be uniquely matched. No metric was converted, no descriptive percentage substituted for the requested test statistic, and no enrollment count substituted for analytic n.
